artDirection: Dark olive study-room illustrations with muted warm highlights

entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE portrait 3:4 project cover for a cohesive seven-image portfolio series. Full-bleed cinematic miniature illustration, sophisticated hand-crafted 3D clay, matte olive ceramic and dark wood, gently rounded forms and tactile detail. This image must blend into a DIM OLIVE GREEN illustrated study-room website background, not stand out as a white product photo. Palette: 80% low-saturation moss and charcoal olive (#242c20 to #46503a), subdued warm brown, small muted ochre accents. Background is a continuous deep olive softly textured plaster wall fading darker toward all four edges, matching the floor, no visible horizon, no frame, no pale backdrop, no beige/white plinth, no large bright surfaces. Subject has soft warm desk-lamp highlights and gentle ambient occlusion, clearly legible midtones, quiet evening mood, no neon or bloom. Central composition occupies 65-75% of the canvas, plenty of breathing room above, objects fully inside frame. Visually expressive and beautiful, concept art rather than screenshot. No text, letters, numbers, brand marks, or logos. Subject: An AI application creation studio: a small dark olive laptop and three layered dark-sage browser panels rising above it, with simple dimensional content blocks, one modest amber speech bubble and a softly glowing copper thread linking an idea to the finished panels. Calm, architectural, no giant orange object.
